recommendedMethod: Ghouls are a low-level Mazchna task west of Canifis, north of Mort Myre Swamp (Priest in Peril required for Morytania access). They have Defence 30 with all defensive bonuses +0, so any melee weapon is equally accurate - bring your best melee setup and a Slayer helmet. They hit up to 5 with melee, so a little food covers the trip. Note they are NOT undead, so the Salve amulet gives no bonus.
